# Code of Conduct

## Our Pledge

We are committed to creating a welcoming, inclusive, and harassment-free environment for everyone.

## Expected Behavior

Examples of positive behavior include:

- Being respectful and professional.
- Providing constructive feedback.
- Helping new contributors.
- Accepting differing viewpoints.

## Unacceptable Behavior

Examples include:

- Harassment or discrimination.
- Personal attacks.
- Trolling or disruptive behavior.
- Publishing private information without consent.

## Enforcement

Project maintainers may remove comments, issues, discussions, or pull requests that violate this Code of Conduct.

Repeated violations may result in temporary or permanent restrictions from participating in the project.

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies to all project spaces including:

- Issues
- Pull Requests
- Discussions
- Project communication channels

## Contact

If you experience or witness unacceptable behavior, please contact the project maintainer.
